name: Loomside
summary: A sales console for a small maker selling online, to shops and at markets, dark first
about: A complete sales app for a small textile studio, with a dark night-indigo look and a light one. Its console weaves the last 28 days of sales into a loom: one thread per channel, thicker where sales were stronger, drawn in as a shuttle passes. Orders, wholesale invoices, products, a drag-and-drop production board, buyers, the team and reports all work.
how: Watch the loom weave in on Console and hover any crossing to see that day's sales for a channel.
Create an order, send it to the loom, then mark it shipped and done.
Drag jobs across the Make board from Queued to Ready, or use each job's Move menu; finished jobs add to stock.
Press Make more on a product to queue a batch for one of the makers.
Write a wholesale invoice, send it, print it and mark it paid; overdue invoices are flagged.
Switch availability for each maker on Team and compare hours with capacity; Reports shows the month against the target.
